scene_description: A woman with long hair stands at a large airport window, holding a handbag and standing next to a rolling suitcase. She is looking out the window at an airplane flying in the sky.

questions.question: What is the big thing flying in the sky?
questions.evidence_hint: Look up in the top part of the picture, in the sky.

questions.question: What is the woman doing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what the woman's body is facing and what she is doing.

questions.question: Where is the woman standing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is right in front of the woman and the big glass behind her.

questions.question: What is the woman carrying with her?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is next to the woman and what she is holding in her hand.

questions.question: What might the woman be getting ready to do?
questions.sentence_frame: She might be getting ready to ___.
questions.evidence_hint: Look at her suitcase and the airplane outside. Think about where people go when they have a suitcase and are at an airport.

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever been on an airplane or to an airport?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you traveled somewhere far away.
